labelProvenance: supervisor AI-reviewed provisional; not human gold or holdout
selectionLimit: File-level proxy only. A secondary file omission is not proof of irrelevance or error; this does not measure link arrival, function/line accuracy, requirement fulfillment, or human task time.

references.goal: Invert the y axis for log as well as linear scales when limits are reversed.
references.rationale: set_ylim swaps reversed bounds; test_inverted_limits explicitly asserts log-axis reversed limits. Ticker helper and 3D changes are secondary, not the first direct 2D behavior evidence.

references.goal: Represent large legend values without losing formatter offset/scientific magnitude.
references.rationale: Both formatter paths disable unrepresented offset/scientific formatting; both tests assert large legend values.

references.goal: Raise ValueError for an empty Blueprint name.
references.rationale: Constructor adds empty-name ValueError; test supplies an empty name and expects ValueError.

references.goal: Report InvalidURL rather than UnicodeError for a dot-leading host.
references.rationale: prepare_url extends invalid-host check to dot prefix; test supplies http://.example.com with InvalidURL.

references.goal: Allow xr.where to preserve x attributes via keep_attrs.
references.rationale: where adds and forwards keep_attrs; test_where_attrs asserts attributes. test_units excerpt is formatting-only, not direct attributes evidence.

references.goal: Allow short -v without an argument, as with --verbose.
references.rationale: utils registers -v and handles single-hyphen preprocessing; test_short_verbose calls -v without a value. Other excerpts only show generic metavar plumbing, not this behavioral route.

references.goal: Avoid array truth-value errors while inspecting mock patch sentinels.
references.rationale: num_mock_patch_args replaces equality membership with identity; integration test excerpt names a numpy-like sentinel regression, although full test is truncated.

references.goal: Keep GaussianMixture fit_predict and predict consistent for n_init greater than one.
references.rationale: Shared fit_predict moves final E-step; GaussianMixture test sets n_init=5 and compares results. Bayesian-specific test is a secondary extension.

references.goal: Render empty tuple annotations without popping an empty list.
references.rationale: Both unparsers handle empty tuples; tests cover Tuple[()] or empty tuple rendering.

references.goal: Simplify multiplying Dagger expressions by IdentityOperator.
references.rationale: Dagger multiplication and Operator dispatch handle identity; tests assert Dagger/identity products.
